channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont Democrats won a veto-proof majority in the state Senate and expanded their House control in this year's election. They flipped multiple seats, including in Orange and Addison counties.
Authorities are looking for a vehicle involved in a crash near West Rutland Town Hall. The crash damaged signage on the town hall's front lawn.

Vermont's Department for Children and Families got a two hundred thousand dollar grant to simplify foster parent fingerprinting. Mobile fingerprinting units will reduce travel for applicants in rural areas.

Lincoln Vermont had a New York City parking ticket rescinded. The ticket was for a five-ton wheel-loader that never left the Lincoln garage. New York City officials admitted the error and canceled the fine.
